notes: GeoTalk 1.8: this update fixes a problem in 1.7 that could stop the app from opening on some phones. Push now starts safely after the app opens — it initializes quietly in the background once the app is on screen, and it can never block or break the app: if anything about push fails on a phone, push simply switches itself off for that version and the app works exactly as before, with calls still arriving while the app is open. Everything from 1.7 is kept in full: FASTER CALLS — the app remembers which connection path actually works on your phone and starts there directly, and it prepares the connection while the phone is still ringing, so calls go live within a couple of seconds of answering on phones where direct UDP voice is the proven path. HD VOICE — live direct-UDP calls use the Opus codec (the same codec family WhatsApp and Telegram calls use): wideband 16 kHz crystal-clear voice that adapts between about 16 and 40 kbps with error correction and loss concealment, staying clear even on slow connections while using roughly ten times less data than before. PUSH — incoming calls arrive by push notification even when the app is completely closed, showing the full call screen with ringtone (this activates as soon as the push service is switched on for your account — no app update will be needed after that). Also kept from 1.6: the independent direct-UDP live voice engine between WebRTC and Push-to-Talk, native crash details in problem reports, the call safety guard that resets on every new version, standard WebRTC connection settings, call signaling on its own dedicated thread, proper telephony audio mode with audio focus, incoming calls ring with your default ringtone and vibration, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
